products.title: Antony
products.description: The Antony is a classic Mulberry satchel designed in functional shape and unisex style. Thoughtfully equipped, it features an adjustable strap that can be worn across the body or over the shoulder. Instantly recognisable, it is designed with the iconic Postman’s Lock detail.
products.details: A classic satchel designed in functional shape and unisex style. Postman's Lock closure Brass hardware finish One main compartment Internal foil embossed Mulberry signature Adjustable leather shoulder strap One external slip pocket Suede and Herringbone lining Height 23.8cm Width 22cm Depth 7cm Shoulder Strap 68cm Weight 0.5kg, approximately Material Bio-Based Scotchgrain This product features a heritage Mulberry material, Scotchgrain, which is durable, lightweight, made from recombined bio-based and recycled materials, and embossed with a distinctive pebble grain finish. The product is trimmed with a calf leather that has a very fine grain and a soft silky touch. This product's code is HS5188-127Q330

rows: 1-2 working days delivery. Next working day on selected orders.
